import { defineAgent } from 'vite-hub/agent'
import { teams } from 'vite-hub/agent/channels'
import { browser, git, inputCommands, mcp, title, usage } from 'vite-hub/agent/capabilities'
import { useRuntimeConfig } from 'nitro/runtime-config'
import { cliproxy, cloudflareAccess } from 'vite-hub/gateways'
import { useServerEnv } from '#vitehub/env/server'
import { sshLaunch } from '@vite-hub/sandbox/ssh'
import packageJson from '../../../package.json' with { type: 'json' }
import { createLibsqlAgentState } from 'vite-hub/agent/state'
import productlaneChannel from '../../channels/productlane'
import { airtableChatAttachments } from '../../channels/airtable/attachments'
import { teamsMessageLinks } from '../../channels/teams/links'
import { githubHost } from '../../channels/github/host'
import { mcpServers } from '../../mcp/servers'
import { quiverSources } from '../../workspace/sources'
import instructions from './instructions.md?raw'
import teamsInstructions from '../../channels/teams/instructions.md?raw'
import browserSkill from 'agent-browser/skills/agent-browser/SKILL.md?raw'

const runnerLaunch = process.env.QUIVER_CODEX_RUNNER === 'crabbox'
  ? sshLaunch({
      host: process.env.CRABBOX_STATIC_HOST || '127.0.0.1',
      port: Number(process.env.CRABBOX_STATIC_PORT || process.env.SSH_PORT || '2222'),
      user: process.env.CRABBOX_STATIC_USER || 'agent',
      identityFile: process.env.CRABBOX_SSH_KEY || '/ssh/id_ed25519',
      hostKeyFile: process.env.SSH_HOST_PUBLIC_KEY || '/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub',
    })
  : undefined

export default defineAgent({
  name: 'bot',
  version: packageJson.version,
  github: githubHost,
  workspace: {
    mode: 'write',
    // A comment inside the Workspace options.
    materialize: 'none',
    sources: quiverSources,
  },
  driver: {
    kind: 'codex',
    instructions,
    capacity: {
      concurrency: 4,
      queue: { maxPending: 12 },
    },
    credentials: () => useServerEnv().codex.auth,
    gateway: cliproxy({ url: 'https://gateway.example.com', headers: cloudflareAccess() }),
    model: 'model',
    permissions: 'allow-all',
    reasoningEffort: 'medium',
    reasoningSummary: 'auto',
    launch: runnerLaunch,
    requirements: ['git', 'gh', 'unzip'],
  },
  channels: {
    productlane: productlaneChannel(),
    teams: teams({
      instructions: teamsInstructions,
      messages: {
        concurrency: 'steer',
        lockScope: 'thread',
        steerFromParticipants: true,
        allowSilentReply: true,
        loading: { text: 'Thinking…', intervalMs: 5000, updates: 'commentary' },
        stream: false,
        durable: false,
      },
      route: true,
      adapter: { userName: 'Bot' },
    }),
  },
  messages: {
    timeout: 15 * 60 * 1000,
    concurrency: 'serial',
    errorFallbackText: ({ defaultText, publicError }) => {
      if (publicError.code === 'PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED') {
        const reset = publicError.details?.resetText
        return [
          'I’ve reached the usage limit for this bot.',
          reset ? `Usage should reset ${reset}.` : 'Usage will reset when the provider quota renews.',
          'Please try again after the reset time.',
        ].join(' ')
      }
      return publicError.code === 'INTERNAL'
        ? 'I couldn’t process that request. Please try again.'
        : defaultText
    },
    final: {
      delivery: 'new-message',
    },
    loading: {
      intervalMs: 5000,
      text: 'Loading…',
      updates: 'commentary',
    },
    triggerHistory: {
      maxImages: 4,
      maxMessages: 50,
      source: 'thread',
    },
    state: () =>
      createLibsqlAgentState({
        url: useRuntimeConfig().chatStateDatabaseUrl,
      }),
    transcripts: {
      maxPerUser: false,
    },
  },
  capabilities: [
    usage(),
    browser({ skillContent: browserSkill }),
    git({ mode: 'write' }),
    title({
      model: 'model',
    }),
    inputCommands({ debug: true }),
    mcp({ servers: mcpServers, unavailableNotice: true }),
    airtableChatAttachments,
    teamsMessageLinks,
  ],
})
